definitions.gloss: firefly viewing; going out to enjoy or catch fireflies
definitions.explanation: The traditional summer pastime of going out on early-summer evenings to watch or catch fireflies near rivers and rice fields.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{蛍狩|ほたるが}りを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: My family enjoyed firefly viewing together.

examples.japanese: {初夏|しょか}の{夜|よる}、{川|かわ}のそばで{蛍狩|ほたるが}りをするのが{毎年|まいとし}の{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: Going firefly viewing by the river on early-summer evenings is my yearly delight.

notes:
Compound of {蛍|ほたる} (firefly) + {狩|が}り (hunting, gathering); the second element voices to がり. Despite the word 'hunting', it usually means simply going out to enjoy the sight of fireflies. A seasonal early-summer ({初夏|しょか}) activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛍狩|ほたるが}りに{行|い}く: to go firefly viewing
- {蛍狩|ほたるが}りを{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy firefly viewing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {潮干狩|しおひが}り: shellfish gathering — uses the same 〜{狩|が}り pattern for a seasonal outing
